title: How to Hear God’s Voice Every Day
titleZh: 每天如何聆聽神的聲音
summaryZh: 每位信徒都蒙召在先知性中運作，重點在於發揮功用，而非追求頭銜。
lines: Why don't you grab your Bibles, open to the Book of Numbers?
各位不妨拿起身邊的聖經，翻到《民數記》。
We have several portions of scripture we're going to read today.
我們今天會讀幾段經文。
I want to talk to you about the prophetic, which I don't do hardly ever anymore.
我想跟你們談談先知性的事，我現在幾乎很少講這個了。
I don't need to, Chris covers it so well.
我也不需要講，克里斯這方面講得太好了。
But I was thinking about it, Chris has his prophetic school this week.
但我剛好想到，克里斯這週有他的先知性學校。
And he's just the best equipper in the prophetic of anybody I've ever met.
在我認識的人當中，他是裝備先知性服事最棒的人。
So how many of you are here for the prophetic school? Put your hands up.
所以你們當中有多少人是來參加先知性學校的？請舉手。
喔，太棒了。歡迎你們，歡迎，歡迎。
I met some of you at the airport yesterday.
我昨天在機場遇到你們當中的幾位。
And always, if I fly home on a Friday or Saturday, flying into Redding from San Francisco,
通常只要我在週五或週六飛回家，從舊金山飛往雷丁時，
I always meet a number of people on the plane that are coming here for something, especially if we have a school or a conference.
我總會在飛機上遇到許多為了某些活動來這裡的人，特別是當我們有舉辦學校課程或特會時。
And so it was fun to see you at the airport, have people stare at you.
所以能在機場看到你們，看著別人盯著你們看，這真的很有趣。
這總是一幅美麗的畫面。
So anyway, this is going to be an incredible week of prophetic training.
總之，這將會是不可思議的一週，充滿先知性的訓練。
But I want to talk to you, and here's the thing that I want to address.
但我想跟你們談談，這就是我想探討的重點。
And we'll look at the scripture to establish this theme.
我們將透過經文來確立這個主題。
But every believer has actually been called by the Lord to live in and function in the prophetic.
實際上，每一位信徒蒙主呼召，都要活在先知性裡，並在其中運作。
It is the call of every believer.
這是對每一位信徒的呼召。
There is a difference between the prophetic anointing, operating in the prophetic, and being a prophet.
擁有先知性的恩膏、在先知性中運作，跟成為一名先知，這之間是有差別的。
I'm not talking about that at all.
If you happen to be one, just don't print out a business card,
如果你剛好就是先知，千萬別印在名片上，
or when you hand me one, I will laugh at you.
否則當你遞給我時，我會笑你。
I don't mind people knowing their titles and stuff, but you know, please.
我不介意人們知道自己的頭銜之類的，但是你知道的，拜託。
Here's a great example: John the Baptist.
有個很棒的例子：施洗約翰。
John the Baptist, Jesus called him the greatest of all Old Testament prophets.
施洗約翰，耶穌稱他是舊約所有先知中最偉大的一位。
And somebody came to John and asked him, "Are you the coming prophet?"
有人來找約翰並問他：「你是那將要來的先知嗎？」
Because the Bible talks about a major prophetic ministry that would exist in the last days.
因為聖經談到在末世會存在一個主要的先知性服事。
And they asked John, "Are you the coming prophet?"
他們問約翰：「你是那將要來的先知嗎？」
So they went to Jesus and asked Jesus,
That's fascinating that you could have the most significant prophetic role in history,
這很令人著迷，你可能在歷史上扮演最重要的先知性角色，
not know your title, but know your function.
卻不知道自己的頭銜，但明白自己的功用。
Function is more important than how people recognize you.
功用比人們如何看待你更重要。
He was able to say, "I am a voice in the wilderness."
他能說：「我是曠野裡的呼聲。」
So I'm okay with the title, but just don't make that your deal.
所以我可以接受頭銜，但不要把那當作你最看重的事。
Otherwise I will quietly laugh, and you don't want that, I know.
否則我會暗自發笑，而我知道你不會希望這樣。
